ideas.pitch: Real-time carbon and traffic optimization app for municipal transit and delivery fleets in Hamilton.
ideas.title: EcoRoute Hamilton
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the architectural pattern of GeoNex-ATLAS by applying spatial intelligence and monitoring to real-world infrastructure problems.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent student mental health and academic support platform tailored for university resource routing.
ideas.title: CampusCare Multi-Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly replicates the winning LangGraph and multi-agent workflow pattern seen in the GreenNovation Hackathon winner.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered trust and patient acquisition platform specifically adapted for local Hamilton health clinics.
ideas.title: MedTrust Local
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the rapid execution framework of the Global-Smile 12-hour sprint winner by focusing heavily on local business adoption.

ideas.pitch: A predictive forecasting dashboard for regional industrial carbon outputs using Poisson regression.
ideas.title: SteelCity Carbon Ledger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs mathematically rigorous forecasting models similar to the Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon winning project.

ideas.pitch: A hyper-local meal recommendation platform that integrates regional grocery store inventory and nutritional data.
ideas.title: NutriLocal Hamilton
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the practical, consumer-facing utility of the E-Foodiee-AI-Nutrition-Assistant that won the Hour Hackathon.
